visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A title screen appears with a blurred background of snack shelves. Pink and white text in Chinese introduces the video's theme: visiting Japanese convenience stores for new products. Logos for FamilyMart, 7-Eleven, and Lawson are displayed at the bottom. (2) A person's hand holds a bag of Ginbis Double Chocolat mini asparagus biscuits in front of a FamilyMart shelf. The hand shows the biscuit, snaps it in half to reveal the texture, and provides a close-up of the bitten piece. (3) The hand holds a pink package of Lotte Crunky chocolate featuring Kirby animation. The background shows convenience store shelves with various items. (4) The scene shifts to a 7-Eleven where a Suage Soup Curry cup is displayed. The hand rotates the cup to show the contents through the transparent lid. (5) In a freezer section of 7-Eleven, the person picks up a Lotte Nama Chocolate Ice package. The hand uses a small wooden stick to lift a cocoa-dusted chocolate ball and takes a bite, showing the creamy white filling. (6) In a Lawson store, a red bag of Aerial chili-flavored corn snacks is shown. The hand shakes the bag slightly to emphasize the product. (7) The final shot shows a box of Meiji Macadamia Winter Limited chocolates. The packaging features white and dark chocolate imagery. The background is a store shelf.

[Variety]: 餅乾香脆, 外苦內甜 超級好吃!!! (3) [Slogan]: 2. LOTTE 星之卡比 草莓CRUNKY (全家限定). [Subtitle]: 全家跟星之卡比聯名的脆餅! 是數量限定的呦～很欠買. (4) [Slogan]: 3. Suage 監修 北海道湯咖哩 (7-11限定). [Subtitle]: 和北海道知名湯咖哩餐廳合作! 不用飛過去就能吃到. (5) [Slogan]: 4. LOTTE 生巧克力冰 (7-11限定). [Subtitle]: 跟平常的雪見大福不一樣! 這是用生巧克力包覆整顆冰淇淋. 今年生巧克力有加量! 甜度比較高, 螞蟻人會愛. (6) [Slogan]: 5. Aerial 食用辣油口味 (LAWSON). [Subtitle]: Aerial玉米餅乾新出了辣油口味! 吃起來還有大蒜香氣喲.
